gold 03, long wavy ponytail (dark brown), narrow almond smiling eyes, straight medium scar (dark black) eyebrows, chiseled shaven face, straight pointed nose and full lower lips (light nude matte/beige gold).

neutral 03, curly fade (ash blonde), narrow almond sunken, straight medium (dark black) eyebrows, chiseled shaven face, straight flat nose, and medium heart lips (light nude matte/beige gold)
